hooks.command: input=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$input" | jq -e '.stop_hook_active == true' >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && cargo xtask docs-gate --base main >/dev/null
hooks.statusMessage: docs gate: checking that code changes carry documentation
